title: Battle of Ning-Jin
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ning-Jin", at revision 1370451758, opens: "The Battle of Ning-Jin was a military conflict between the Later Jin dynasty and the Ming dynasty. In the spring of 1627, the Later Jin khan Hong Taiji invaded Ming territory in Liaoning under the pretext of illegal construction on Later Jin territory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q10946104, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "one battle in Chinese history between Ming and Qing". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
